title.narrative: FSDA Zambia Landscape of Climate Finance 2025

description.narrative: FSD Africa’s vision is that Africa can unlock new pathways to prosperity and resilience while helping the world realise the promise of the Paris Agreement and tackle the dual crises of climate change and biodiversity loss. The Africa Climate Summit highlighted the contribution that Africa can make to mitigating global climate change as well as identifying opportunities for ensuring that Africa’s development is aligned with both the mitigation and adaptation goals of the Paris Agreement. Central to this alignment will be finance – both domestic and international, public and private. Fundamentally, this work will build upon CPI’s methodology and benefit from recent work in thematic sectors (e.g., agriculture, buildings, nature). It will provide FSD Africa,and national stakeholders with updated, actionable data on climate finance to guide their policy and investment strategies.
